mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting a flight to safety that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 96.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling a weakening economy and triggering a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 96.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% within a single month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to predict negative returns in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 212.5 and a decline in GDPC1 below 11340.0 signals stagflationary pressures—rising inflation with weakening real GDP—leading to central bank inaction and equity market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 212.5 and GDPC1 < 11340.0 fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%), indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 50.0 and UNRATE > 8.5% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%), indicates a deepening supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 97.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 8.5% fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
